text: This report provides information on the proposed installation of a plaque identifying Mino Bimaadiziwin (the 'Good Life'), the new Indigenous Art Feature Wall in Centennial Square Park, and articulating the significance of this concept, as well as acknowledging the artists and partners who made this art piece possible.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the installation of a plaque identifying Mino Bimaadiziwin, the new Indigenous Art Feature Wall in Centennial Square Park, and articulating the significance of this concept, as well as acknowledging the artists and partners who made this art piece possible.
